# Libraries
```{r}
library(pafr, quietly = TRUE)
library(patchwork)
```


# Read Data

## Read PAFs

```{r}
pafdirW <- "../../alignments/W/"
pafdirZA <- "../../alignments/ZA/"

alnWfiles_asm5   <- dir(pafdirW, pattern = "asm5")
alnWfiles_asm20  <- dir(pafdirW, pattern = "asm20")
alnWfiles_def    <- dir(pafdirW, pattern = "default")
alnZAfiles_asm5  <- dir(pafdirZA, pattern = "asm5")
alnZAfiles_asm20 <- dir(pafdirZA, pattern = "asm20")
alnZAfiles_def   <- dir(pafdirZA, pattern = "default")
```

### Clean up labels

```{r}
alnLabels <- gsub(pattern = "(\\S+?)_.*_vs_(\\S+?)_.*", 
                  replacement = "\\1_vs_\\2",
                  x = alnWfiles_asm5)
qryLabels <- gsub(pattern = "(\\S+?)_.*_vs_(\\S+?)_.*", 
                  replacement = "\\1",
                  x = alnWfiles_asm5)
qryLabels[qryLabels == "p50han"] <- "p50"

names(alnWfiles_asm5) <- qryLabels
names(alnWfiles_asm20) <- qryLabels
names(alnWfiles_def) <- qryLabels

names(alnZAfiles_asm5) <- qryLabels
names(alnZAfiles_asm20) <- qryLabels
names(alnZAfiles_def) <- qryLabels


```


### Import pafs

```{r}
pafsWasm5   <- lapply(alnWfiles_asm5, function(x) {
  read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirW,x)) })
pafsWasm20  <- lapply(alnWfiles_asm20, function(x) {
  read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirW,x)) })
pafsWdef    <- lapply(alnWfiles_def, function(x) {
  read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirW,x)) })
pafsZAasm5  <- lapply(alnZAfiles_asm5, function(x) {
  read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirZA,x)) })
pafsZAasm20 <- lapply(alnZAfiles_asm20, function(x) {
  read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirZA,x)) })
pafsZAdef   <- lapply(alnZAfiles_def, function(x) {
  read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirZA,x)) })

```


## Chrom order reference
Need this for specifying order of chroms in `pafr` dotplots.
```{r}
chroms <- readLines("../../config/autosomes_Z.txt")
```

# Plot

## Plot W

### Generate W plots for `asm5`
```{r}
dotplotWasm5 <- list()
for (i in seq_along(pafsWasm5)) {
  dotplotWasm5[[i]] <- dotplot(ali = pafsWasm5[[i]], 
                           line_size = 0.5,
                           ylab = "p50T",
                           xlab = qryLabels[i],
                           alignment_colour = "blue3") + 
    coord_flip() + # could swap axes to have reference on X axis
    theme_classic()
}
```



```{r,fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
wrap_plots(dotplotWasm5) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "W chromosome, asm5")
  
```

```{r}

                           line_size = 0.5,
                           ylab = "p50T",

  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "W chromosome, default")
  
```

Write plot to external file.

```{r}
outW_pafr <- wrap_plots(dotplotWdef) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) 
ggsave(filename = "../results/Wpafr_default.jpg", plot = outW_pafr,
       width = 180, height = 90, units = "mm", scale = 1.7)
```


## Plot Z & Autosomes

### Generate ZA plots for `asm5`

```{r}
dotplotZAasm5 <- list()
for (i in seq_along(pafsZAasm5)) {
  dotplotZAasm5[[i]] <- dotplot(ali = pafsZAasm5[[i]], 
                           line_size = 0.5,
                           ylab = "p50T",
                           order_by = "provided", 
                           ordering = list(chroms,chroms),
                           xlab = qryLabels[i],
                           alignment_colour = "green4") + 
    coord_flip() + # could swap axes to have reference on X axis
    theme_classic()
}
```



```{r, fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
wrap_plots(dotplotZAasm5) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Z & autosomes, asm5")
  
```

## Single Chromosome



```{r}

chromNow <- "ChrZ"
dotplotChrom <- list()
for (i in seq_along(pafsZAasm20)) {
  chrAli <- subset(pafsZAasm20[[i]], qname == chromNow & tname == chromNow, ) 
  dotplotChrom[[i]] <- dotplot(ali = chrAli, 
                           line_size = 0.5,
                           ylab = "p50T",
                           #order_by = "provided", 
                           #ordering = list(chroms,chroms),
                           xlab = qryLabels[i],
                           alignment_colour = "green4") + 
    coord_flip() + # could swap axes to have reference on X axis
    theme_classic()
}
```




```{r, fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
wrap_plots(dotplotChrom) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = chromNow)
  
```
